subject: Consolidating scope + addendum for renewal and order form (signing plan)
messages:
From: Jordan Gordon <jgordon@sundialhealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sundial Health Procurement <procurement@sundialhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Jun 2029 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Sundial renewal — scope questions and draft redlines

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the QBR last week — the team is aligned on moving forward but we need a few paperwork items locked before procurement can sign. High level:
- Term: prefer 18 months instead of 12 (syncs with our fiscal planning)
- Capacity: we want to add a 30% buffer for peak compute during onboarding months 1–3
- Order form: we’d like the new seats and embedding units consolidated onto one updated order form rather than an amendment chain

Attached is a quick draft of redlines from our legal team (Sundial_Draft_Redlines_v1.docx). Can Redwood provide a consolidated addendum + order form reflecting pricing and a brief ramp schedule? Also, we have a one-page vendor questionnaire outstanding — can we get a copy of your data retention language to include in that?

Goal: get to signature by end of June. Who should we work with on an executable addendum?

Thanks,
Jordan Gordon
Director, Procurement
Sundial Health

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Gordon <jgordon@sundialhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Jun 2029 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sundial renewal — scope questions and draft redlines

Jordan — thanks for the clear ask and the draft redlines. We can absolutely consolidate into a single addendum + new order form. Proposed plan:
1) Redwood will produce a consolidated addendum (MSA updates + term amendment) and a one-page ramp schedule tied to the order form pricing.
2) Legal (cc’d: Karthik) will provide a Riverside-style redline with comments on indemnity/retention items you flagged.
3) Sales (cc’d: Marissa) will confirm billing/contact and expedite pricing approval.

Quick asks from our side to speed the process:
- Confirm preferred signer (Sundial: procurement director or finance head?)
- Confirm whether the 30% buffer is permanent or a transient uplift for months 1–3
- Any regulatory constraints on retention beyond standard SOC2 controls?

I’ll attach an early Redwood redline and a draft order form by EOD. If that sounds good I’ll target a consolidated doc set for your review by Wednesday.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Account Director, Renewals & Expansion
Redwood Inference

Attachments: RW_Consolidated_Addendum_v2_redline.docx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Gordon <jgordon@sundialhealth.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Jun 2029 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sundial renewal — scope questions and draft redlines

Jordan — quick note from the pricing side:
- OrderForm_2029Q3_Sundial.pdf attached with line items for seats, embedding units, and the 30% temporary buffer as a separate billable line (opt-in for months 1–3).
- Preferred signer: Procurement Director (Jordan — please confirm full name and email for DocuSign routing).
- Billing contact: lisa.sanchez@sundialhealth.com (cc’ing for confirmation).

If procurement confirms the buffer as transient, we’ll price it as a short-term uplift rather than a permanent tier change (helps with forecasting). I’ll hold the DocuSign envelope until legal gives final redline OK.

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: OrderForm_2029Q3_Sundial.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Gordon <jgordon@sundialhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Jun 2029 11:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sundial renewal — scope questions and draft redlines

Jordan / team — I reviewed Sundial's draft redlines and added targeted edits in the consolidated addendum. Key notes:
- Term: we can accept an 18-month term but ask for an early-termination pro-rata on prepaid credits (Section 3.1 language updated).
- Section 4.2 (Service Levels): proposing a narrow SLA credit amendment tied only to the newly added capacity tiers (we do not want to expand the base SLA exposure across legacy workloads).
- Indemnity and data retention: we can keep standard MSA indemnity language; for data retention I propose we reference the SOC2-aligned retention schedule and add a line for customer-specific retention only if required by regulation (need a one-sentence statement from Sundial if this applies).

I’ve attached line-by-line comments in RW_Consolidated_Addendum_v2_redline.docx. Two questions for Sundial to confirm: 1) will the 30% buffer be billed monthly as used or invoiced up-front as a commitment? 2) Are there any EU-data residency constraints we should be aware of (regionally client mention)?

If this is acceptable, Marissa — please confirm pricing stance and I’ll prepare a clean counter for signature.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: RW_Consolidated_Addendum_v2_redline.docx

From: Jordan Gordon <jgordon@sundialhealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Jun 2029 07:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sundial renewal — scope questions and draft redlines

Team — appreciate the quick turn. A few clarifications:
- Signer will be Procurement Director: Jordan Gordon (same as me) — route to jgordon@sundialhealth.com for DocuSign.
- Buffer billing: we prefer monthly billing on actual usage for months 1–3, with a capped not-to-exceed invoice matching the 30% sizing — this preserves flexibility.
- Data retention: no EU residency constraints, Sundial follows standard HIPAA-adjacent healthcare guidelines; we’ll accept SOC2 references provided you add the one-sentence retention confirmation.

We reviewed Karthik's redline and are comfortable with the term and the limited SLA carve for the ramped capacity. Two asks before send-to-signature: 1) a one-page mutual action plan (MAP) showing ramp milestones and success criteria; 2) confirmation that the buffer line will be marked as temporary in the order form.

If you can get the consolidated clean copy + MAP by Monday we’ll ready procurement for signature.

Thanks,
Jordan

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Gordon <jgordon@sundialhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Jun 2029 09:41:00 -0700
Subject: Final consolidated package and signing plan — Sundial renewal (next steps)

Jordan — attaching the consolidated clean set per the discussion:
- RW_Consolidated_Addendum_v2_clean.docx (MSA term updates + one-sentence retention confirmation)
- OrderForm_2029Q3_Sundial.pdf (buffer line marked as "transient: months 1–3")
- Sundial_MAP_1pager.pdf (mutual action plan with milestones and acceptance criteria)

Summary of agreed points:
- Term: 18 months (with pro-rata on prepayments)
- Buffer: 30% temporary uplift, billed monthly as-used for months 1–3, capped per order form
- SLA: limited carve to apply only to ramped capacity tiers (see Addendum Section 4.2)
- Data retention: SOC2-based schedule + one-sentence confirmation included in the addendum

Next steps:
1) Marissa to confirm final pricing line and send DocuSign envelope to jgordon@sundialhealth.com and lisa.sanchez@sundialhealth.com.
2) Jordan to route to finance for final PO if required.
3) Karthik will standby for any final signature-related redline questions (rare).

Targeting execution by 30 Jun. Let me know if anything is missing.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Account Director, Renewals & Expansion
Redwood Inference

Attachments: RW_Consolidated_Addendum_v2_clean.docx, OrderForm_2029Q3_Sundial.pdf, Sundial_MAP_1pager.pdf
